BlockRef.description: A block, shaped as read-v1's snapshot: what a read or an event is true at.
BlockRef.title: BlockRef

ChainBalances.description: One chain's balances; `totalUsd` once every balance above zero has a value.
ChainBalances.title: ChainBalances

ChainBalancesRequest.description: Without tokens: every chain's base currencies (its charge currencies).
ChainBalancesRequest.title: ChainBalancesRequest

ChainBalancesResponse.description: chain-balances: a wallet's native and token balances on each chain asked, one block per chain.
ChainBalancesResponse.title: ChainBalancesResponse

ChainPoolsResponse.description:
chain-pools: the token's pools against the chain's base currencies (or the paired token), Uniswap's standard
hookless keys and the enabled v3 tiers, read at one block; listed when priced and holding liquidity.
ChainPoolsResponse.title: ChainPoolsResponse

ChainTokensResponse.description: chain-tokens: the tokens Domino knows on Base or Arbitrum One that match a query (known tokens only).
ChainTokensResponse.title: ChainTokensResponse

Custody.description:
The root's custody. `armed` is the vault's live rootArmed() as last read.
A reason comes from the last RootDisarmed after the last RootRearmed
(`event`), or, with no such event, from the live read alone (`live_read`:
the owner approved another app on v4, or moved it, without a notification).
Custody.title: Custody

EthUsd.description: The Chainlink ETH/USD round behind a price: the profile's feed (its proxy), the answer and its time.
EthUsd.title: EthUsd

FeaturedPoolsRequest.description: The route takes no parameters: the list is the same for everyone.
FeaturedPoolsRequest.title: FeaturedPoolsRequest

Gas.description:
The receipt's own fields, as the chain reports them: gas used times the
effective price is the execution fee; on OP Stack the receipt's L1 data
fee is separate. No total is claimed: a stack may charge what the receipt
does not state (an operator fee).
Gas.title: Gas

LiveToken.description:
A token's metadata as read at the block: untrusted text, decimals null when unread, never guessed; its USD
price, or why it has none.
LiveToken.title: LiveToken

LiveWindowCoverage.description: Coverage of a window served from live state: no stored interval exists.
LiveWindowCoverage.title: LiveWindowCoverage

MarketsSnapshotResponse.description: Stored server-side snapshot; served without touching any provider.
MarketsSnapshotResponse.title: MarketsSnapshotResponse
x-domino-constraints: requested pool ids are echoed exactly as sent; pools lists every stored entry; not_built is the explicit empty state

Member.description: A member's life from the vault's events.
Member.title: Member

MemberState.description: IDominoVaultLedger.member and its two lots, as read.
MemberState.title: MemberState

PoolActivityLiveWindow.description:
A pool whose creation is verified but whose ledger is not walked yet.

The 24 h window is exact, computed from the pool's own logs over a block
range whose start timestamp proves every event lies inside the window. No
stored revision, range model, lifetime total or fee ledger is claimed.
PoolActivityLiveWindow.title: PoolActivityLiveWindow

PoolActivityStored.description: A walked pool: the stored ledger answers with its own revision and model.
PoolActivityStored.title: PoolActivityStored

PoolAprEstimate.description: Internal candidate model; not an addition to any public read-v1 route.
PoolAprEstimate.title: PoolAprEstimate

PoolMarket.description:
The pool's depth in USD within the band: what it releases of `reference`, the token's partner, as the token is
sold into it until its price falls by PRICE_BAND_PERCENT. No TVL, volume or APR.
PoolMarket.title: PoolMarket

PoolMetricsResponse.title: PoolMetricsResponse
x-domino-constraints: usableAsCurrent24h requires qualified_historical_calculation, complete24h capital and valuation, fresh snapshot, and non-null feeAprPercent

ReservesReturned.description:
A closed vault's reserves paid to its owner by a returnReserves() someone else sent: the automation's operator
sends one once the root is closed and no successor is active, and the call is open to anyone. The owner's own
withdrawals (withdrawReserves, exitAll) stay vault_event.
ReservesReturned.title: ReservesReturned

SwapFees.description: What a swap pays in each direction, in pips of its input: v4's protocol fee taken before the LP fee.
SwapFees.title: SwapFees

TokenBalance.description: A balance as read, its token's USD price or why it has none, and its value at that price, rounded down.
TokenBalance.title: TokenBalance

TokenListRef.description: The curated list's provenance: the Uniswap Labs Default token list (GPL-3.0), as pinned in the release.
TokenListRef.title: TokenListRef

TokenPrice.description:
A qualified USD price: the chain's stable, the feed's ETH, or a pool's spot against one of them at the block read,
with the pool and its depth within the band.
TokenPrice.title: TokenPrice

Waiting.description:
Why the automation's last pass did not act on this vault or mandate, or
that it would (`eligible`, `triggered`): its fixed code (`too_soon`,
`gas_not_covered`, `owner_benefit_insufficient`, `earnings_evidence_missing`,
`vault_paused`, `root_disarmed`, `trigger_not_reached`,
`v2_observation_unstable`, `reverted_<error>`, ...; any other code is shown
as such), at the head of that pass (`checkedAt`, `checkedBlock`). `since`
and `sinceBlock` are the time and block of the first pass that gave this
reason, as the automation records them: kept while the reason holds, reset
when it changes.
Waiting.title: Waiting

WaitingReport.description:
The chain's automation's last pass, as its waiting file says: the head
it decided at. `not_configured`: the chain's indexer reads no automation
file; `unavailable`: its last read found the file missing or malformed.
WaitingReport.title: WaitingReport

WaitingRevert.description: The last presimulation that reverted, kept until one passes.
WaitingRevert.title: WaitingRevert

schema.title: Response 200 Pool Activity V1 Read Pool Activity Post
